title: Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408): hoax, cipher or language

plaintext.source: No published decipherment has a reproducible key (literature sweeps, SOURCES.md).

transcription.source: Zandbergen-Landini ZL3b-n (EVA, 13 May 2025); cross-checked on RF1b-er, IT2a, GC2a, CD2a
transcription.notes: Year is a point inside the radiocarbon range 1404-1438. Counts are word tokens and types of paragraph text as given in NOTES, not measured with --measure.

system.summary: Undetermined: plain or simply enciphered European language excluded on transliteration-robust entropy; a verbose encoding and structured meaningless text remain roughly even.
system.notes: Glyph inventory depends on the transliteration (EVA, v101 68 symbols, Currier 35).

prior_solution.where: Published decipherments (Bax 2014 to 2025-26 LLM readings) have no reproducible key

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: character and word statistics scripts a1-a6 with verifier re-runs v_a1-v_a6
b1-b4 segmentation, long-range and robustness tests

solution.what: Five sweeps, one per hypothesis or evidence class.
Conditional entropy h2 across transliterations and glyph segmentations against eleven European languages.
Plaintext, monoalphabetic substitution, transposition, abjad or single-null padding of eleven European languages.
Verbose-cipher controls of Latin: matches h1/h2 but gives words 2.3 times too long.
Implemented hoax generators (table-and-grille, self-citation autocopist) against word grammar, Zipf and self-citation statistics.
Adversarial re-run of every test by a separate agent; corrected figures adopted.

outcome.notes: An adjudication, not a decipherment: verbose encoding vs structured meaningless text judged about 45:50.
